hook: Isolated lending pools fragment collateral by requiring separate deposits for every borrow.
body: In Vanna, collateral is deposited once into a SmartAccount, where account health is assessed across the entire account. A SmartAccount can deploy deposited and borrowed assets into approved external protocols while retaining debt to lending pools, allowing one collateral balance to back multiple positions.
thread: Isolated lending pools fragment collateral. Assets deposited into single-purpose pools remain locked for individual borrows. Capital does one job when it could support several positions at once.

In Vanna, collateral is posted once into a SmartAccount. Account health is assessed across the entire margin account. On testnet, the borrow guard counts borrowed capital on both sides because borrowed funds cannot leave the account.
A SmartAccount can deploy deposited and borrowed assets into approved external protocols while retaining debt to the lending pools. One collateral deposit backs multiple positions.
